name: MCPCat
description: Order McDonald's and Luckin coffee in one sentence, plus real-time weather, express tracking, DNS and price data via one MCP endpoint.
description_zh: 一句话点麦当劳、瑞幸咖啡，并提供实时天气、快递物流轨迹、汇率油价、DNS检测等数据查询服务。点餐下单前会先预览并与您确认。
description_en: Order McDonald's or Luckin coffee with one sentence, and query real-time weather, express tracking, exchange rates, oil prices and DNS status through a single MCP endpoint. Orders are previewed and confirmed before checkout.
examples_zh: 帮我在最近的麦当劳门店点一份早餐，到店取
用瑞幸帮我点一杯生椰拿铁，预览一下别支付
查一下北京明天天气和顺丰单号SF1234567890的轨迹
examples_en: Order breakfast at the nearest McDonald's for pickup
Preview a Luckin iced coconut latte without paying
Check tomorrow's weather in Beijing and my SF Express tracking
